methodologyNotes: Covers portable 12V DC compressor (and thermoelectric) fridge/freezers marketed for cars, RVs, vans, overlanding and off-grid use, sold at a published US price. Excludes fixed RV absorption refrigerators, residential mini-fridges, and passive (non-powered) ice coolers. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. capacityLiters is total interior volume in liters (L); for dual-zone units it is the combined volume of both compartments. zoneConfig is an enum: 'single-zone' or 'dual-zone'. minTempCelsius is the lowest published setpoint in degrees Celsius (lower is colder). coolingType is an enum: 'compressor' or 'thermoelectric'. inputVoltages is a string listing supported power inputs (e.g. '12/24V DC, 100-240V AC'). ratedPowerWatts is rated/maximum electrical draw in watts (W). hasBattery is a boolean: true if an integrated rechargeable battery is included or offered as an attachable module. batteryCapacityWh is the integrated battery capacity in watt-hours (Wh); null if the unit has no battery. hasIceMaker is a boolean for a built-in ice maker. hasApp is a boolean for WiFi and/or Bluetooth app temperature control. weightKg is empty (unloaded) weight in kilograms (kg).
